overview: Sefef is a two-component cloud-native task management application consisting of a Go/net-http REST API backend and a React/TypeScript single-page frontend. The backend handles all business logic, authentication (JWT sessions), and data persistence via a PostgreSQL database, exposing a versioned REST API consumed by the frontend. The frontend is a static SPA served as a web-application component, communicating exclusively with the backend API over HTTPS.
requirements: Users can register with a unique email and password meeting minimum complexity (≥8 chars, ≥1 letter, ≥1 number).
Users can log in with email/password and receive a session token; sessions expire after a defined inactivity period.
Users can log out, immediately invalidating their session.
Users can request a password reset email sent to their registered address.
Each user can only access their own tasks and categories; data is fully isolated per user.
Users can create a task with at minimum a title; optional fields include description, due date (with optional time), category, and priority (Low/Medium/High).
Users can read a list of all their tasks and view full details of a single task.
Users can update any field of an existing task.
Users can delete a task permanently (requires client-side confirmation step).
Users can toggle a task's completion status (complete/incomplete) with a single action.
Users can create, rename, and delete named categories.
Deleting a category uncategorizes all tasks previously assigned to it.
Each task belongs to at most one category.
Users can filter tasks by status (all/incomplete/complete), category, and due date range (today/this week/overdue).
Users can sort tasks by due date, creation date, or priority.
Users can search tasks by keyword matched against title and description.
Tasks past their due date and still incomplete are flagged as overdue.
All task list views must load within 2 seconds under normal network conditions.
Form inputs provide immediate inline validation feedback before submission.
Passwords are stored as secure hashes (bcrypt); never in plain text.
All client-server communication is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS).
Unauthenticated requests to protected resources receive a 401 response; the frontend redirects to login.
The application protects against XSS (output encoding, CSP headers) and CSRF (token or SameSite cookie strategy).

info:
  title: Sefef API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Backend REST API for the Sefef task management application.
servers:
  - url: /api/v1
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      operationId: healthCheck
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Service is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
  /auth/register:
    post:
      summary: Register a new user
      operationId: registerUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '409':
          description: Email already in use
  /auth/login:
    post:
      summary: Log in
      operationId: loginUser
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authenticated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '401':
          description: Invalid credentials
  /auth/logout:
    post:
      summary: Log out
      operationId: logoutUser
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Session invalidated
  /auth/password-reset/request:
    post:
      summary: Request a password reset email
      operationId: requestPasswordReset
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email]
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Reset email sent if account exists
  /auth/password-reset/confirm:
    post:
      summary: Confirm password reset with token
      operationId: confirmPasswordReset
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token, password]
              properties:
                token:
                  type: string
                password:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Password updated
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '410':
          description: Token expired or invalid
  /categories:
    get:
      summary: List all categories for the authenticated user
      operationId: listCategories
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of categories
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
    post:
      summary: Create a new category
      operationId: createCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CategoryRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Category created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /categories/{categoryId}:
    parameters:
      - name: categoryId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    put:
      summary: Rename a category
      operationId: updateCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/CategoryRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated category
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    delete:
      summary: Delete a category (tasks become uncategorized)
      operationId: deleteCategory
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Deleted
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
  /tasks:
    get:
      summary: List tasks with optional filters and sorting
      operationId: listTasks
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [all, complete, incomplete]
            default: all
        - name: category_id
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
        - name: due_filter
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [today, this_week, overdue]
        - name: due_from
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date
        - name: due_to
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date
        - name: priority
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [low, medium, high]
        - name: sort
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [due_date, created_at, priority]
            default: created_at
        - name: order
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [asc, desc]
            default: desc
        - name: q
          in: query
          description: Keyword search against title and description
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of tasks
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
    post:
      summary: Create a new task
      operationId: createTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskRequest'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Task created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
  /tasks/{taskId}:
    parameters:
      - name: taskId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    get:
      summary: Get a single task
      operationId: getTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Task detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    put:
      summary: Update a task
      operationId: updateTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskRequest'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/BadRequest'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
    delete:
      summary: Delete a task permanently
      operationId: deleteTask
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Deleted
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
  /tasks/{taskId}/complete:
    parameters:
      - name: taskId
        in: path
        required: true
        schema:
          type: string
          format: uuid
    patch:
      summary: Toggle task completion status
      operationId: toggleTaskComplete
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [complete]
              properties:
                complete:
                  type: boolean
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/NotFound'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer

    BadRequest:

          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
    NotFound:
      description: Resource not found
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse'
  schemas:
    AuthRequest:
      type: object

        email:

    AuthResponse:
      type: object

        token:
          type: string

    User:

          format: date-time

      properties:
        title:
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        due_date:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
        category_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          nullable: true
        priority:
          type: string

      type: object

components.componentAgentInstructions:
## sefef-api — Go REST Backend

### Overview
Implement a production-ready REST API in **Go** using only the standard library (`net/http`) plus a small set of well-known packages. The service listens on **port 9090**. All data is stored in a **PostgreSQL** database whose DSN is provided via the environment variable `DATABASE_URL`. Use `github.com/lib/pq` or `pgx/v5` as the Postgres driver and `database/sql` for queries. Use `golang-jwt/jwt/v5` for JWT handling and `golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt` for password hashing.

### Project Structure
```
/sefef-api
  main.go
  Dockerfile
  go.mod / go.sum
  internal/
    db/         # migrations + db init
    handler/    # HTTP handlers per domain
    middleware/ # auth, logging, CORS
    model/      # domain structs
    service/    # business logic
    validator/  # input validation helpers
```

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_URL` | PostgreSQL DSN | required |
| `JWT_SECRET` | Secret for signing JWTs | required |
| `JWT_EXPIRY_HOURS` | Token TTL in hours | `24` |
| `SESSION_INACTIVITY_MINUTES` | Sliding session window | `60` |
| `SMTP_HOST`, `SMTP_PORT`, `SMTP_USER`, `SMTP_PASS`, `SMTP_FROM` | Email config for password resets | optional |
| `PORT` | HTTP listen port | `9090` |
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | Comma-separated CORS origins | `*` |

### Database Schema (run at startup via migrations)
```sql
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "pgcrypto";

CREATE TABLE users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE password_reset_tokens (
  token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  used BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE
);

CREATE TABLE categories (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(user_id, name)
);

CREATE TABLE tasks (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  category_id UUID REFERENCES categories(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  due_date TIMESTAMPTZ,
  priority TEXT CHECK (priority IN ('low','medium','high')),
  complete BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_user_id ON tasks(user_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_due_date ON tasks(due_date);
CREATE INDEX idx_tasks_category_id ON tasks(category_id);
```

### Authentication & Sessions
- **Register** (`POST /api/v1/auth/register`): Validate email uniqueness and password complexity (≥8 chars, ≥1 letter, ≥1 digit). Hash password with bcrypt cost 12. Insert user. Return JWT.
- **Login** (`POST /api/v1/auth/login`): Look up user by email, compare bcrypt hash. Return JWT on success; 401 on failure. Do not leak whether email exists.
- **Logout** (`POST /api/v1/auth/logout`): Maintain an in-memory or DB-backed JWT blocklist (store `jti` claim in a `revoked_tokens` table with TTL cleanup). Mark token as revoked. Return 204.
- **JWT**: Include claims `sub` (user UUID), `jti` (random UUID), `iat`, `exp`. Sign with HS256. Sliding expiry: each request with a valid token that is within the last 50% of its life issues a new token in the `X-Refresh-Token` response header.
- **Password Reset**: Generate a cryptographically random 32-byte token, store hashed in `password_reset_tokens` with a 1-hour expiry. Send a reset link via SMTP (if configured); if SMTP is not configured, log the link to stdout at INFO level. The confirm endpoint validates the token, checks expiry, resets password, marks token used.

### Middleware Stack (applied in order)
1. **Logger**: log method, path, status, duration.
2. **CORS**: set `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` from `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` env; handle preflight OPTIONS.
3. **Security Headers**: `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, `Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'`, `Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin`.
4. **Auth** (protected routes only): Parse `Authorization: Bearer <token>`, validate JWT signature and expiry, check `jti` not revoked, inject `userID` into request context.

### Endpoint Behaviors

#### Tasks
- **GET /api/v1/tasks**: Build a dynamic SQL query based on query parameters.
  - `status=complete` → `WHERE complete = TRUE`; `status=incomplete` → `WHERE complete = FALSE`.
  - `category_id=<uuid>` → `WHERE category_id = $n`.
  - `due_filter=today` → due_date between start-of-day and end-of-day (UTC); `this_week` → next 7 days; `overdue` → `due_date < NOW() AND complete = FALSE`.
  - `due_from` / `due_to` → date range bounds.
  - `priority=<level>` → filter by priority.
  - `q=<keyword>` → `WHERE (title ILIKE '%keyword%' OR description ILIKE '%keyword%')`.
  - `sort` + `order` → ORDER BY clause; map `priority` sort to `CASE WHEN priority='high' THEN 1 WHEN priority='medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END`.
  - Always scope to the authenticated user: `WHERE user_id = $1`.
  - JOIN categories to include `category_name` in the response.
  - Compute `overdue` field server-side: `due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date < NOW() AND complete = FALSE`.
- **POST /api/v1/tasks**: Validate `title` non-empty. If `category_id` is provided, verify it belongs to the authenticated user (return 400 if not). Insert and return created task.
- **GET /api/v1/tasks/:id**: Fetch by id AND user_id; 404 if not found.
- **PUT /api/v1/tasks/:id**: Full update. Validate same rules as POST. Set `updated_at = NOW()`. Verify category ownership if category_id supplied.
- **DELETE /api/v1/tasks/:id**: Delete where id AND user_id match; 404 if not found.
- **PATCH /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete**: Set `complete = $1, updated_at = NOW()` where id AND user_id match.

#### Categories
- All operations scoped to authenticated user.
- **DELETE /api/v1/categories/:id**: Delete category; due to `ON DELETE SET NULL`, tasks become uncategorized automatically.
- Enforce unique category name per user at DB level (unique constraint) and return a user-friendly 409 error.

### Validation Helper
Create a reusable `validator` package:
- `ValidatePassword(p string) error` — enforces ≥8 chars, ≥1 letter, ≥1 digit.
- `ValidateEmail(e string) bool` — basic RFC format check.
- `ValidateUUID(s string) bool`.
- Return structured error maps `{"field": "message"}` as `400 Bad Request` JSON.

### Health Endpoint
`GET /health` — returns `{"status": "ok", "db": "ok"}`. Ping the database; if ping fails return `{"status": "degraded", "db": "error"}` with HTTP 503.

### Dockerfile
```dockerfile
FROM golang:1.23-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o server ./main.go

FROM alpine:3.20
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=builder /app/server .
EXPOSE 9090
CMD ["./server"]
```

### Error Handling
- Always return JSON error bodies matching `ErrorResponse` schema.
- Never expose stack traces or internal error messages to the client.
- Log internal errors server-side with context.

### Edge Cases
- Category deletion with tasks: handled by DB `ON DELETE SET NULL` — no extra logic needed.
- Duplicate email registration: catch unique constraint violation, return 409.
- Invalid UUIDs in path params: return 400 immediately before hitting DB.
- Expired/invalid JWT: return 401 with `{"error": "unauthorized"}`.
- All timestamps stored and returned in UTC ISO 8601.

components.componentAgentInstructions:
## sefef-web — React / TypeScript SPA

### Overview
Build a responsive single-page application using **React 18** + **TypeScript** + **Vite**. Use **TailwindCSS** for styling and **React Query (TanStack Query v5)** for server state management. Use **React Router v6** for client-side routing. The app communicates exclusively with `sefef-api` via the `VITE_API_BASE_URL` environment variable (default: `/api/v1`).

### Project Structure
```
/sefef-web
  Dockerfile
  vite.config.ts
  tailwind.config.ts
  tsconfig.json
  package.json
  public/
  src/
    main.tsx
    App.tsx
    api/          # typed API client functions
    components/   # shared UI components
    pages/        # route-level page components
    hooks/        # custom React hooks
    store/        # auth token context/store
    types/        # shared TypeScript interfaces
    utils/        # validation, date helpers
```

### Environment Variables
| Variable | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `VITE_API_BASE_URL` | Backend API base URL | `/api/v1` |

### Authentication & Routing
- Store the JWT in `localStorage` under `sefef_token`. On app boot, read the token and validate it (check expiry client-side). If expired or absent, redirect to `/login`.
- Check for `X-Refresh-Token` response header on every API response. If present, silently replace the stored token.
- Implement a `<PrivateRoute>` wrapper that redirects unauthenticated users to `/login`.
- Routes:
  - `/login` — Login page
  - `/register` — Registration page
  - `/reset-password` — Request reset form
  - `/reset-password/confirm?token=...` — New password form
  - `/` — Task list (private)
  - `/tasks/:id` — Task detail/edit (private)

### Pages & Components

#### Login & Register
- Inline validation before submit: email format, password complexity (≥8 chars, ≥1 letter, ≥1 digit). Show field-level error messages immediately on blur.
- Show loading state on the submit button.
- On success, store token and redirect to `/`.
- On API error, display the error message inline (not in an alert dialog).

#### Task List Page (`/`)
- Top toolbar: search input (debounced 300ms), filter dropdowns (Status, Category, Due Date, Priority), sort selector.
- Task cards in a scrollable list. Each card shows: title, priority badge (colored: High=red, Medium=amber, Low=blue), category chip, due date, completion checkbox.
- Overdue tasks: highlight the due date in red and add an "Overdue" badge.
- Completed tasks: visually dimmed with a strikethrough on the title.
- FAB or button to create a new task (opens a slide-over panel or modal).
- Optimistic updates for completion toggles: immediately update UI, roll back on API error.

#### Task Create / Edit (modal or slide-over)
- Fields: Title (required), Description (textarea), Due Date+Time (datetime-local input), Category (select from user categories + "No category" option), Priority (Low/Medium/High toggle buttons).
- "Clear due date" button to nullify the due date.
- Inline validation: title must not be empty.
- Delete button (only in edit mode) triggers a confirmation dialog before calling DELETE API.
- On save, invalidate the `tasks` React Query cache to refresh the list.

#### Category Management
- Accessible via a sidebar or settings menu.
- List all categories with inline rename (click to edit, press Enter or blur to save) and delete buttons.
- Deleting a category shows a confirmation: "Tasks in this category will become uncategorized."

### API Client (`src/api/`)
Create typed async functions for every API operation:
```typescript
// Each function throws on non-2xx responses, parsing the ErrorResponse body
export async function listTasks(params: TaskFilters): Promise<Task[]>
export async function createTask(data: TaskRequest): Promise<Task>
export async function updateTask(id: string, data: TaskRequest): Promise<Task>
export async function deleteTask(id: string): Promise<void>
export async function toggleComplete(id: string, complete: boolean): Promise<Task>
export async function listCategories(): Promise<Category[]>
export async function createCategory(name: string): Promise<Category>
export async function updateCategory(id: string, name: string): Promise<Category>
export async function deleteCategory(id: string): Promise<void>
export async function login(email: string, password: string): Promise<AuthResponse>
export async function register(email: string, password: string): Promise<AuthResponse>
export async function logout(): Promise<void>
export async function requestPasswordReset(email: string): Promise<void>
export async function confirmPasswordReset(token: string, password: string): Promise<void>
```
All requests attach `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header from localStorage. Intercept 401 responses globally to clear the token and redirect to `/login`.

### Types (`src/types/index.ts`)
```typescript
interface Task {
  id: string; title: string; description: string | null;
  due_date: string | null; category_id: string | null; category_name: string | null;
  priority: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high' | null;
  complete: boolean; overdue: boolean;
  created_at: string; updated_at: string;
}
interface Category { id: string; name: string; created_at: string; }
interface TaskFilters {
  status?: 'all' | 'complete' | 'incomplete';
  category_id?: string; due_filter?: 'today' | 'this_week' | 'overdue';
  due_from?: string; due_to?: string; priority?: 'low' | 'medium' | 'high';
  sort?: 'due_date' | 'created_at' | 'priority'; order?: 'asc' | 'desc'; q?: string;
}
```

### Performance
- Use React Query's `staleTime: 30_000` for task lists to avoid redundant refetches.
- Debounce search input by 300ms before triggering API call.
- Use `React.memo` and `useCallback` on task card components to prevent unnecessary re-renders.
- Lazy-load the task detail/edit modal with `React.lazy` + `Suspense`.

### Security
- Sanitize any user-generated content rendered as HTML using `DOMPurify` (or avoid `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` entirely — prefer text rendering).
- Do not store sensitive data beyond the JWT in localStorage.

### Health Endpoint
Serve a static `/health` file via Nginx returning `{"status": "ok"}` with `Content-Type: application/json`.

### Dockerfile
```dockerfile
# Build stage
FROM node:22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# Serve stage
FROM nginx:1.27-alpine
COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
EXPOSE 80
```

### nginx.conf
```nginx
server {
  listen 80;
  root /usr/share/nginx/html;
  index index.html;

  # SPA fallback
  location / {
    try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
  }

  # Static health check
  location /health {
    return 200 '{"status":"ok"}';
    add_header Content-Type application/json;
  }

  # Security headers
  add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff;
  add_header X-Frame-Options DENY;
  add_header Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin;
}
```

### Edge Cases
- If categories API fails, still render the task list with no category filter options; show a non-blocking toast error.
- If a task's category_id is set but category_name is null (deleted category race condition), display "Uncategorized".
- Completion toggle: use optimistic update; on rollback show a toast "Failed to update task".
- Empty state: when no tasks match the current filters, show an illustrated empty state message with a CTA to create a task or clear filters.
- Long task titles: clamp to 2 lines with `text-ellipsis` in card view; show full title in detail/edit view.
